content: Suresh Deshmukh confirmed to Aditi Mahajan that her auto policy for the 2019 Honda Civic (Policy #AU-2019-HC) has been successfully cancelled within the 30-day cooling-off period. A full refund of $1,200.00 will be issued to her original payment method within 5-7 business days, and the cancellation confirmation document was attached. Aditi acknowledged the update and requested notification once the refund is posted.

action_items: Process and post the $1,200.00 refund to the customer's original payment method
Notify the customer once the refund has been posted
